Just got a 6.5 Ruger precision the other day. Pretty happy with it but I've only put one box of 120gr GMX Superformance and I only got at best .9" at 100 yards. Anybody else got a Ruger Precision?

You're never going to squeeze the same performance out of that rifle shooting factory ammo as you can handloading your own. You might get lucky and find a factory load that your rifle really likes, but the absolute best way to do it is to tune your ammo to the rifle.

I'm sure this isn't what you want to hear, but if you don't plan to load your own you probably should have bought the .308 version. It will do everything the 6.5 does inside of 600 yards and factory ammo is way less expensive.

That being said, what you want to do is match your projectiles to the twist rate of your barrel. The Ruger has a 1:8 twist which is on the faster end for 6.5 Creedmoor. The heavier 6.5 projectiles do have the best ballistic coefficient and your barrel should stabilize them just fine. I suspect you'll see better precision with the 140gr+ loads.

I do want to reload eventually but I'm not able to afford the set up right now. There are people that report 1/2" groups with certain factory loads. Honestly I don't need to shoot .25" groups or anything just wanted to squeeze the best accuracy out of the box.
